name: Mapbox Geocoding
description: A commercial geocoder, worldwide: an address to a point and a point to its address, with house-number precision where Mapbox has it. Read by @nexgen-os/mapbox, in the permanent mode, the one whose results Mapbox's terms let a customer store; asked after the country's register and the open fallback.
license: Mapbox Terms of Service and product terms: results of temporary geocoding may not be stored; permanent geocoding (permanent=true, billed per request) may be stored by the customer; neither may be redistributed as a dataset
